summary: String lookup helper: normalizes the input string, searches a hash table owned by this, and returns the stored string pointer if the entry is found, otherwise returns null. Callers are UI control handlers, suggesting name/key lookup for UI state.

operations.description: Normalize the input string lpSrcStr by calling sub_589901.
Search the hash table (this) for the normalized string and keep the found entry.
If the hash table search returned a non-null entry, return the string pointer via StringPointerAccessor_a2d0; otherwise return null.
Return the accessed string pointer on a hit, or null on a miss.
